SECTIONS.C: Mile 70.2 to Mile 66 trestle (Skutz Falls, Marie Canyon)
SECTIONS.D: Mile 66 trestle to the Sandy Pool sign (Stoltz Pool area)

coho.where: Riverbottom Road pools (Stoltz, Sandy Pool); slow deep holding water and back eddies
coho.gear: Vibrex #3-4 (green water) or #2 (low/clear) in brass, silver, chartreuse or pink, treble swapped for a single barbless siwash; 3/8 oz pink/purple twitching jig; Corky or Spin-N-Glo in pink/orange
coho.fly: 8 wt sink tip, pink or chartreuse Clouser or rabbit strip
coho.play: Fresh fish push on the rise; fish the drop as it clears (it falls slowly here)
coho.extra: Retaining salmon needs the non-tidal salmon stamp.

chum.gear: Same spinners and jigs, chartreuse/pink; bigger profile is fine
chum.play: Retention is still TBD on the DFO table: treat as catch and release

steelhead.where: Duncan through the middle river; tailouts and soft edges
steelhead.gear: Float: 1/8 oz jig (1/4 high and coloured, 1/16 low and clear); unscented bubblegum pink worm; Corky/Spin-N-Glo #14 to #8, bigger as colour comes in; brass or silver Colorado
steelhead.fly: Swing a sink tip: egg-sucking leech or intruder in black, purple or pink; stones in March
steelhead.play: Fish the drop after a freshet; in high water work the soft edges close to shore
steelhead.timing: all day, slow presentation in cold water
steelhead.extra: Steelhead stamp; release wild fish. New log jams since 2025: scout drifts.

egg.where: Chinook redds (Bible Camp up to the lake); tailouts and seams just below them
egg.gear: Float with an unscented 8-10 mm bead pegged above a single barbless hook (gear water only)
egg.fly: Indicator, single egg 8-10 mm in peach/apricot plus a pale cream; late Nov on, flesh fly (pale pink/tan bunny #4-6); streamers in low light
egg.play: Stay below the redds and never wade on them; leave spawning browns alone
egg.timing: eggs midday; streamers first and last light

spring.where: Upper river (Greendale down to Skutz until Apr 15, then up to the lake)
spring.gear: Small spinners or spoons in gear water
spring.fly: White/pearl bead-head streamer or fry pattern #6-8; March Brown dries (Adams #12) 12:30-2:30 from mid-April; golden stones in March
spring.play: Big browns key on emerging salmon fry from late March
spring.timing: streamers first and last light; dries midday

coho.gear: Vibrex #3-4 brass/chartreuse on a single barbless siwash · 3/8 oz pink jig
coho.fly: 8 wt sink tip, pink or chartreuse Clouser
coho.play: Fish the drop as it clears after the push
coho.note: Non-tidal salmon stamp to keep one

chum.play: Retention TBD, treat as catch and release

steelhead.gear: Float a 1/8 oz jig or unscented pink worm · Corky #14-8 by clarity
steelhead.fly: Sink tip, black/purple/pink leech or intruder
steelhead.play: Fish the drop after a freshet, soft edges when high

egg.gear: Float an unscented 8-10 mm bead above a single barbless hook
egg.fly: Indicator + 8-10 mm egg, peach and pale cream · flesh fly from late Nov
egg.play: Tailouts and seams below the redds, never wade on them
egg.when: eggs midday, streamers at first/last light

spring.fly: White/pearl fry streamer #6-8 · March Brown dry #12 midday

STANDING_RULES: Single barbless, bait ban (keep it unscented), release wild trout and wild steelhead, no fishing within 100 m of the Skutz fishway or counting fence.
